methodology: Owner free-cash-flow DCF on a mid-cycle margin. Reported FCF is materially overstated for this issuer: IFRS-16 lease principal repayments sit in financing (FY2026 JPY 42,784m) and must be deducted, interest & dividend income (JPY 8,125m) is stripped because net cash is added back separately, and roughly 24-26% of consolidated profit and cash flow belongs to non-controlling interests. FY2026 owner FCF is JPY 22.9bn (1.13% of revenue) versus JPY 77.98bn reported.

inputs.sbc_note: No material share-based payment expense disclosed; Japanese issuer with negligible SBC. No SBC adjustment applied.

historical_growth.growth_rationale: 5yr revenue CAGR of 9.9% is inflated by FX translation (yen weakness) and the FY2024 consolidation step-up, not unit volume. Company guidance for FY2027 was revised DOWN at Q1 to revenue JPY 2,100bn (+3.1%). Base case uses 3.0% decelerating to 1.0% terminal, reflecting a mature, volume-linked Toyota-group supplier.

wacc_rationale: Risk-free 1.8% (10yr JGB), ERP 5.5%, beta ~1.15 gives ~8.1% cost of equity. Structural premiums added: Toyota-group customer concentration +1.5%, extreme cyclicality (owner FCF ranged JPY 3.2bn-64.0bn over 6 years, a ~20x peak-to-trough spread) +1.5%, NCI/governance complexity +0.5%. Base WACC 11.6%.

bear.label: Volume decline, margin stays at FY2025 trough level

base.label: Mid-cycle owner-FCF margin 1.75%, modest volume growth

bull.label: Margin recovery toward FY2022/24 peaks, company hits its 5% OP-margin ambition

entry_price.method: Price at which buying today, receiving 5 years of projected owner FCF and exiting at scenario terminal value, earns a 15% IRR.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Implied P/E 13.7x equals the 10yr average; implied P/B 0.66x sits BELOW the 10yr minimum of 0.79x and implied EV/EBITDA 2.15x below the 10yr minimum of 2.29x. The valuation is conservative rather than aggressive, which is expected given the base year was mid-cycled DOWN and lease principal is charged in full.
sanity_check.fix_applied: None required. An exit EV/EBITDA cap set to the historical range (bear 2.29x, base 2.86x, bull 3.22x) was added as a discipline; it binds only in the bull case, where Gordon-growth TV of JPY 533bn was capped to JPY 349bn.
sanity_check.note: Multiples are computed on the owner/parent basis and will not match Yahoo or screener figures, which use group GAAP EPS and ignore the NCI and lease-principal adjustments.

valuation_philosophy: Toyota Boshoku screens cheap on reported figures (P/B 0.82x, EV/EBITDA 2.9x) and the balance sheet is genuinely strong -- net cash of JPY 89bn on borrowings. The problem is cash conversion, not the multiple. Once IFRS-16 lease principal (JPY 42.8bn/yr and rising) and the ~24% minority interest are charged, owner free cash flow in FY2026 is JPY 22.9bn -- about 1.1% of revenue and roughly 29% of the headline FCF. On a mid-cycle 1.75% owner-FCF margin the base case is JPY 1,784 per share, about 20% below the market. This is not a distressed business: it is a low-margin, capital-intensive assembler whose value depends almost entirely on whether the OP margin recovers from 2.6% toward management's 5% ambition. The bull case, which assumes that recovery, only reaches JPY 2,372 -- barely above today's price. The market is already paying for the turnaround.
